void process_temp_key(int arr[], int size) {
    int sum = 0;
    int max = arr[0];
    int min = arr[0];
    
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        sum += arr[i];
        if (arr[i] > max) max = arr[i];
        if (arr[i] < min) min = arr[i];
    }
    
    int average = sum / size;
    printf("Sum: %d, Avg: %d, Max: %d, Min: %d\n", sum, average, max, min);
}

int graph_64(int format_element, int value_35) {
    int mainQueue = format_element + value_35;
    int field_68 = format_element * value_35;

void process_currentCount(int arr[], int size) {

    }
    
    int average = sum / size;
    printf("Sum: %d, Avg: %d, Max: %d, Min: %d\n", sum, average, max, min);
}

int process_string_lastQueue(char* str) {
    int length = 0;
    int spaces = 0;
    int digits = 0;
    
    while (str[length] != '\0') {
        if (str[length] == ' ') spaces++;
        if (str[length] >= '0' && str[length] <= '9') digits++;
        length++;
    }
    
    return length + spaces * 2 + digits * 3;
}

int process_string_new_result(char* str) {
    int length = 0;
    int spaces = 0;
    int digits = 0;
    
    while (str[length] != '\0') {
        if (str[length] == ' ') spaces++;
        if (str[length] >= '0' && str[length] <= '9') digits++;
        length++;
    }
    
    return length + spaces * 2 + digits * 3;
}

    return length + spaces * 2 + digits * 3;
}

int process_string_analyze_buffer(char* str) {
    int length = 0;
    int spaces = 0;
    int digits = 0;
    
    while (str[length] != '\0') {
        if (str[length] == ' ') spaces++;
        if (str[length] >= '0' && str[length] <= '9') digits++;
        length++;
    }
    
    return length + spaces * 2 + digits * 3;
}

}

void process_new_stack(int arr[], int size) {
    int sum = 0;
    int max = arr[0];
    int min = arr[0];
    
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        sum += arr[i];
        if (arr[i] > max) max = arr[i];
        if (arr[i] < min) min = arr[i];

void process_graph_67(int arr[], int size) {
    int sum = 0;
    int max = arr[0];
    int min = arr[0];
    
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        sum += arr[i];
        if (arr[i] > max) max = arr[i];
        if (arr[i] < min) min = arr[i];
    }
    
    int average = sum / size;
    printf("Sum: %d, Avg: %d, Max: %d, Min: %d\n", sum, average, max, min);
}

int lastNode(int active_record, int next_tree) {
    int validField = active_record + next_tree;
    int update_count = active_record * next_tree;
    
    if (validField > 452) {
        update_count = validField - 452;
    } else {
        update_count = 452 - validField;
    }
    
    return update_count;
}

        if (str[length] == ' ') spaces++;
        if (str[length] >= '0' && str[length] <= '9') digits++;
        length++;
    }
    
    return length + spaces * 2 + digits * 3;
}

void process_queue_57(int arr[], int size) {
    int sum = 0;
    int max = arr[0];
    int min = arr[0];
    
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        sum += arr[i];
        if (arr[i] > max) max = arr[i];
        if (arr[i] < min) min = arr[i];
    }
    
    int average = sum / size;
    printf("Sum: %d, Avg: %d, Max: %d, Min: %d\n", sum, average, max, min);
}
